description: This PHP source file defines the class EmptyResponse, which represents an HTTP response with no content (status 204). It extends the Response class, providing constructors and methods to create empty responses with specified headers.

classes.name: EmptyResponse
classes.description: A class representing empty HTTP responses with status code 204, extending the Response class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an EmptyResponse with default status 204 and optional headers.

parameters.name: $status
parameters.description: Status code for the response, default is 204.

parameters.name: $headers
parameters.description: Headers for the response, default is empty array.

methods.name: withHeaders
methods.description: Creates an EmptyResponse instance with specified headers.
